name: dice-sanctum
description: A 3D dice table with real physics for tabletop role-playing with Claude as the game master: the player rolls in the browser, every roll reaches the session, and the master's own dice land on the same tray.

player_name.title: Player name
player_name.description: The name of whoever rolls at the table, as the game master reads it in the results. Leave it empty for "the player".
